integrity: A direct proof and standalone exhaustive prime-field subring-closure checker are included. Finite checks are corroboration and no independent mathematical audit or certification has been performed.
limitations: Applies to unital ring generation by positive-length tuples in incidence algebras over finite fields; not arbitrary coefficient rings, non-unital generation, or generation conditional on unit status. The field-product Frobenius count and scalar-assisted algebra generation are acknowledged prior contributions. Some earlier generator-classification primary text remains inaccessible.
title: Frobenius-orbit generation law for finite-field incidence rings
